title: Northgate Tire Center Claim Fitting Charge — Replacement History Rate Table
content:
# Replacement history rate on the claim fitting charge

The Northgate Tire Center claim fitting charge carries a replacement history rate read from the count of **road hazard replacement entries and treadwear claim entries recorded on the package together**, whatever their service dates — entries dated after the claim entry are included.

## Decision table

| Road hazard replacement entries plus treadwear claim entries on the package | Replacement history rate |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1 — the full rate, no reduction |
| 1 | 1 — the full rate, no reduction |
| exactly 2 | 0.9 |
| 3 | 0.8 |
| 4 or more | 0.8 |

Put as a rule: a count of at least 3 takes 0.8; a count of exactly 2 takes 0.9; a count below 2 takes the full rate of 1.

## Counting points

- Both kinds of entry count, and they are added together: road hazard replacements and treadwear claims.
- The count covers the whole package, every wheel position together.
- The treadwear claim entry whose fitting is being charged is itself a treadwear claim entry on the package and is counted.
- Service dates do not limit the count; an entry dated after the claim entry is counted too.

## How the rate acts

The claim fitting charge is multiplied by the replacement history rate. The rate acts on the unrounded charge, and the charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Hypothetical cases

| Entries on the package | Count | Rate | A $28.00 fitting charge before this rate becomes |
|---|---|---|---|
| one treadwear claim | 1 | 1 | $28.00 |
| one road hazard replacement and one treadwear claim | 2 | 0.9 | $25.20 |
| two road hazard replacements and one treadwear claim | 3 | 0.8 | $22.40 |
